responsibility: Bridges GCC’s DWARF DIE graph to the CTF/BTF container by traversing DWARF-generated type and declaration DIEs and translating them into CTF container entries. It owns DIE-to-CTF type generation for base, pointer, typedef, array, struct/union, enum, function, qualifier, void, and unknown types; generation of CTF variable and function records; creation of synthetic DIEs needed for void, array-index, and unknown placeholders; wrappers that expose source-location information from DWARF DIEs to CTF/BTF consumers; and the initialization/finalization sequencing that chooses whether the collected container is emitted as CTF or BTF.
same_name_distinction: Implements the DWARF-to-CTF/BTF bridge declared in dwarf2ctf.h by traversing GCC DWARF DIEs, synthesizing placeholder DIEs when needed, translating them into CTF container entries, and deciding early vs late CTF/BTF finalization.
